description: Serial falls in the FY49 T-33A 49-0857/49-0989 block; Aerial Visuals records the full block designation T-33A-1-LO and construction number 580-5105; on loan from the National Museum of the USAF - the 2016 NMUSAF loan list carries T-33A 49-0955 to VFW POST 781 NORTH HUNTINGDON PA; the post is at Irwin postal address but in North Huntingdon Township. Presence confirmed in current aerial imagery.
